SERVICES AGREEMENT AND STATEMENT OF WORK

This Services Agreement is made on September 2, 2026, between Brightwater Clinics Group ("Client") and Mara Okafor, an independent contractor ("Contractor"). Both parties are fictional.

1. Services. Contractor will provide user research and interview synthesis services for Client's patient booking app, as described in this statement of work.

2. Deliverables. Contractor will deliver twelve recorded patient interviews, a written findings report, and a one-hour readout to Client's product team. Interviews may take place on Client's premises or by video call.

3. Schedule. Contractor will deliver the findings report within six weeks after the start date.

4. Fees and Invoices. Client will pay Contractor a fixed fee of $9,600. Contractor will invoice 50% on signing and 50% on delivery of the findings report. Client will pay each invoice within 30 days of receipt.

5. Expenses. Client will reimburse pre-approved travel expenses on submission of receipts with the final invoice.

6. Confidentiality. Contractor will keep Client's patient information and business information confidential and will not share it with any third party. Contractor will not upload interview recordings to any tool whose terms of service allow the provider to keep or train on the data.

7. Ownership. On full payment, Client owns the findings report and the deliverables created under this agreement. Contractor keeps ownership of her pre-existing research methods and templates.

8. Independent Contractor. Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee of Client. Contractor is responsible for her own taxes and equipment.

9. Termination. Either party may terminate this agreement on ten days' written notice. Client will pay Contractor for services performed up to the termination date.

10. Governing Law. This agreement is governed by the laws of the state where Client has its principal office.

Client: Brightwater Clinics Group
Contractor: Mara Okafor
